title: Cootie's 1973 lung illness
summary: Taken ill after playing A Train, Cootie was sent home by Dr. Arthur Logan, hospitalised, and told to rest a year.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: He didn't play enough for anybody that wanted to hear him. Well, anyway, I'm glad to hear you say that. That's beautiful. Well, then, the last thing now, Cootie, you got sick in '73, didn't you?
Yeah.
Yeah. Right about '73. How did it come about? How did you find that out and so on? Or you just

Yeah. We was playing up at the race track. We played the matinee. I went out to play the "A Train". I come back to my seat, and they wanted me to take a bow, and I couldn't hardly get up to take a bow.
Suddenly?
Suddenly. Yeah. I had been feeling bad.
Yeah.

I said, "Something's wrong. I got to go back home. I got to go home. There's definitely something wrong with me." I had been to the doctor before we left here. And I go back to my doctor, Dr. Arthur Logan, and he take an x-ray of my lung. And we was leaving out the next day.
For where?
We were going down south.
Yeah.
Doing some one nighters. And we was down at an Army base, Camp LeJeune, I think.
Yeah.

And he says, "Well, call me back on Wednesday. Call home on Wednesday, and find out." This was on a Saturday or Sunday or something. I called home, and my wife says, "Well, Dr. Logan says you've got to come home right
Oh.
I got right out of there right away. I caught the next plane.
I'll bet you did.
And come home.
I guess that's the last thing that ever crossed your mind.
Yeah. And I wasn't going to play anymore.
Well, especially with a lung, and blowing so hard.

I had hated to give it up. No, I said, this is it. So the band went to Europe. I was only in the hospital -- how long was I in the hospital? About three or four weeks, I think. The put me right in the hospital. I had a private room. They sent me on home. But I had to take the medicine for a year.
No kidding. Did you start to feel -- get more strength then?
Yeah.
Slowly, huh?
Yeah.
Yeah.
And after I took my medicine for a year,
they took me off the medicine. I had to go back every two months. Then they started every three months, like that. Every six months. Now I go back once a year for a checkup.
Yeah. Yeah.
